newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Bank Austria upgrades Graboplast to 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria upgrades Graboplast to 'buy'.

text.p: Bank Austria Investment said on Monday it upgraded its 1997 and 1998 profit forecasts for home improvement product maker Graboplast, and raised its recommendation on the shares to 'buy' from 'accumulate'.
The change in Bank Austria Investment's opinion follows the release of better-than-expected first-half company figures last week.

"Taking into consideration the exceptionally good H1 figures, the (company's) promising new markets, the developing favourable dollar/mark crossrate for H2 and the potential new capacities, we are upgrading our profit forecasts for both 1997 and 1998," analyst Andrea Dicso said in an update.

Graboplast's first-half consolidated operating profits rose to 1.062 billion forints in the first half of 1997 from 719.9 million in the first half of 1996, while its after-tax profit rose to 1.097 billion forints from 423.1 million.
Dicso estimated Graboplast's earnings per share would reach 580.3 forints in 1997 and 754.4 forints in 1998.
